$comment: Spec §9.2. Source: Formulation Knowledge Base §3 substrate-to-food map.

substrates.name: Lactose
substrates.notes: Body's own lactase commonly declines by adulthood.

substrates.name: GOS (raffinose, stachyose)
substrates.notes: No native human enzyme — hard colon deadline.

substrates.name: Inulin-type fructans
substrates.notes: No native human enzyme. Garlic and onion carry more short-chain fructans than inulin.

substrates.name: Excess fructose
substrates.notes: Absorbed via a narrower fructose-only pathway.

substrates.name: Polyols (sorbitol, mannitol)
substrates.notes: No commercial enzyme exists. KB Table A: limited / under development.

substrates.name: Dietary protein
substrates.notes: Pepsin plus pancreatic proteases already digest protein thoroughly — supplementing is additive.

substrates.name: Dietary fat
substrates.notes: Lingual, gastric and pancreatic lipase already cover most fat digestion.
